summary: Korea Electric Power Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing its unaudited consolidated and separate financial results for the first half of fiscal year 2026 under K-IFRS. The filing provides condensed income statements showing operating revenues, operating income, and net income for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026, compared to 2025. No special-situation event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change, is present. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
